title: Review of c42's arena-size coexistence finding on fresh seeds 10-13: 0/4 coexist at 32^2, 4/4 at 96^2
summary: The food-chain claim world unchanged. labkit on seed 10 at 32^2 and 96^2 (t=12000, --lineage-k 5): at 32^2 the predators are gone by the end (0 components, 0 persistent splits) and 4 prey remain; at 96^2 13 predators and 3 prey remain, prey persistent splits 12 (generation 7) and predator persistent splits 12. c42's drive.py on seeds 11-13 scored with the finding's rule (coexist.py: predators at every count from t=6000, prey at >= 50%): 32^2 0/3 (seed 12 loses its predators at t=2100, seeds 11 and 13 have gaps in the predator record or prey below half), 96^2 3/3 (prey present at 100% of late counts). Together 0/4 at 32^2 and 4/4 at 96^2, as in the finding (0/4 and 4/4).

observations.F: coexist.txt: L32 seeds 11-13 'no' (pred_last 12000/2100/12000, prey_frac 0.43/1.00/0.62), L96 seeds 11-13 'coexist' (prey_frac 1.00); rerun_L32/seed10 predators 0 at the end; rerun_L96/seed10 13 predators, 3 prey; drive/L32_s12.png: predators vanish by t=2100 and the prey freeze into a static lattice

controls_run.F: two arena sizes at fixed parameters, same seeds

verdicts.limitation: Only the two extreme sizes; the intermediate sizes (48, 64) where the finding saw 2/4 and 3/4 were not re-run. The coexistence rule is the author's (predator gaps of one count fail a run).
